svg.title: Form Studio, building
svg.desc: The Form Studio workspace while a design builds: sensor case, line 6 of the program, Board screw holes, being built. The part stands in a pool of light with its size so far on dimension lines, the features built so far are solid and the rest of the design is a faint plot. The program lists the features in build order: Shell, Cavity, Corner bosses, Insert / screw holes, PCB standoffs, Board screw holes, USB-C openings, Round holes, Lid, Lid lip, Lid screw holes, Vent slots, Label and stamp.
svg.text: Ask about Sensor case, or describe a change…
